mainEntity.name: What metrics should I track to measure the success of my GEO for FAQ Pages efforts?

acceptedAnswer.text: To measure the success of your GEO for FAQ Pages efforts, track several key metrics. These include an increase in organic traffic to your FAQ pages, particularly from local search queries. Monitor your local search ranking for target keywords and phrases. Look at conversion rates from users who landed on FAQ pages, such as form submissions or calls. Additionally, keep an eye on bounce rate and time on page for your optimized FAQs, as these indicate engagement. Tools like Google Analytics and Google Search Console are essential for monitoring these metrics.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track organic local traffic, local search rankings for target keywords, conversion rates from FAQ visitors, and engagement metrics like bounce rate and time on page.
